sources.title: Taking part in the UK Emissions Trading Scheme markets

facts.source_fact: Auctioning is the primary means of introducing UK allowances into the market.
Eligible account types include installation operator holding accounts, aircraft operator holding accounts and qualifying trading accounts.
A bidder must hold an account in the UK Emissions Trading Registry.
UK ETS operators and aircraft operators can be eligible bidders.
Qualifying members of operator groups can be eligible.
Qualifying business groupings of operators can be eligible.
Certain UK public or state bodies controlling operators can be eligible.
Certain UK investment firms and credit institutions with relevant Part 4A permissions can be eligible.
Certain third-country investment firms and credit institutions with relevant Part 4A permissions can be eligible.
Market participants must also be registered with ICE Futures Europe to take part in UKA auctions.
